servers.title: Choose a server
servers.lead: Open the server you want to configure Devi on.
servers.add_lead: You can manage these servers, but Devi isn't there yet.
servers.empty_text: Devi isn't on any server you can manage. Add it to one of your servers to get started.
servers.unavailable_text: The dashboard can't reach the bot, so it can't tell which servers have Devi. Try again in a minute.

not_configured.title: The dashboard isn't available
not_configured.text: It hasn't been set up on this site yet.

login_failed.title: Couldn't sign you in
login_failed.text: Discord didn't confirm the sign-in. Try again in a moment.

login_cancelled.title: Sign-in cancelled
login_cancelled.text: Without access to your account we can't show your servers. You can try again whenever you like.

guild.forbidden_text: Ask a server administrator to give you the Admin permission in Devi, or sign in with another account.
guild.not_found_text: Add Devi to the server first, then come back here.
guild.unavailable_text: The dashboard can't reach the bot. Try again in a minute.

permissions.name: Permissions
permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.lead: Devi has its own permissions, separate from Discord roles. Pick who they apply to, then choose what they can do.

birthdays.name: Birthdays
birthdays.title: Birthday channel
birthdays.lead: Devi congratulates members on their birthday in this channel.

logs.name: Logs
logs.title: Log channel
logs.lead: Devi posts server events here: messages, members, voice activity, moderation actions and used commands.

voice.name: Temporary voice
voice.title: Temporary voice channels
voice.lead: Members who join the lobby get a voice channel of their own. It's deleted when everyone leaves.

triggers.name: Triggers
triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.lead: When a message matches a pattern, Devi replies with one of the replies at random.

channels.cant_send: Devi can't send messages in this channel. Give it the View Channel and Send Messages permissions.

logs.label: Log channel
logs.hint: Devi needs permission to view and send messages in this channel.

birthdays.label: Birthday channel
birthdays.hint: Members set their birthday with /birthday set. Devi checks every day at {hour}:00 UTC.

voice.lobby_hint: Members who join this voice channel get a channel of their own.
voice.template_hint: [user] is replaced with the owner's nickname.
voice.bot_perms: Devi needs the Manage Channels and Move Members permissions to create these channels and move members into them.

scope_hint.guild: Applies to every member of the server.
scope_hint.role: Applies to everyone who has this role.
scope_hint.channel: Applies to actions performed in this channel.

permissions.pick_hint: Pick a role, channel or member to edit.

Admin.desc: Turns on every allowed action below at once. Restrictions stay separate.
Admin.label: All Permissions

ManageMention.desc: Use /mention without the count limit and cooldown, and stop it with /mention stop.
ManageMention.label: Manage Mentions

TTS.desc: With /tts, Devi reads text aloud in a voice channel.
TTS.label: Text-to-Speech

Send.desc: Send messages and direct messages as Devi with /send.
Send.label: Send DMs

triggers.empty_text: Create a trigger and Devi will answer matching messages on its own.
triggers.pattern_hint: A regular expression, not case-sensitive. A plain word like hello matches any message that contains it; use ^ and $ to match the whole message.
triggers.replies_hint: Devi picks one reply at random each time.

errors.csrf: This page is out of date. Reload it and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
errors.bot_unavailable: Devi is offline right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Can't reach the site. Check your connection.
errors.invalid_channel: This channel can't be used here.
errors.name_template_too_long: The channel name is too long ({max} characters at most).
errors.invalid_request: The request was rejected. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid_target: That role or channel no longer exists.
errors.unknown_user: That member isn't on this server.
errors.too_many_changes: Too many changes at once. Save fewer items at a time.

errors.trigger_not_found: This trigger no longer exists. Reload the page.
